summary: Regression on rebrand + Resend integration. Backend 5/5 pytest passing (test_inquiries.py tightened to assert `id` is returned and `_id` is NOT exposed on both POST and GET). Backend logs show 'RESEND_API_KEY not set — skipping inquiry email notification' warning on each create, and NO 500s — the fire-and-forget notify task never breaks the request. Frontend verified across all 7 routes at desktop (1920x1080) and mobile (390x844): no old-identity references (Aarav / aarav.chisel / 919876543210 / Mumbai / aaravmehta), 0 broken images and 0 hidden elements on any page (ClipIn/reveal fix confirmed), 0 horizontal overflow, correct branding (wa.me/919527471066, instagram.com/Atharvliftss, mailto:Info@Atharvliftss.in) on every page. Home hero renders 'THE PHYSIQUE IS THE SCULPTURE.' with both CTAs (Book a Free Consult / See the Programs) and the stone-graded photo visible (screenshot). Contact form: empty submit shows toast 'Name and a phone or email are needed.'; valid submission renders data-testid='inquiry-success' and record is retrievable via GET /api/inquiries. Mobile hamburger overlay opens with all 7 nav items visible (screenshot). No console JS errors on any page. Testimonials/stats copy per spec.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: create_inquiry uses asyncio.create_task(_notify_owner(...)) — fire-and-forget task is never awaited and exceptions are only caught inside _notify_owner; acceptable here because the function already try/excepts, but consider a global task registry or BackgroundTasks (FastAPI) for observability.

server.py: created_at stored as ISO string; sort('created_at', -1) currently relies on lexicographic ordering (works for ISO-8601 UTC Z-suffix, but not once a locale/offset is introduced). Prefer datetime type.
server.py: OWNER_EMAIL default is hard-coded to Info@Atharvliftss.in in code — fine, but ensure it stays in sync with .env (which already defines it).
No rate limiting on POST /api/inquiries — public marketing endpoint; consider a lightweight IP throttle before launch to prevent spam once Resend is wired up.
test_credentials: None — public marketing site, no auth.
seed_data_creation: Two TEST_-prefixed inquiries (TEST_Priya via pytest, TEST_Regression2 via Playwright contact form) inserted into MongoDB inquiries collection.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Both bugs from iteration 1 are fixed: (1) ClipIn/LineRevealOnScroll now reveal correctly — 0 hidden imgs across all 7 pages; (2) Inquiry response returns `id` (no `_id`). Resend is gracefully no-op'd via the RESEND_API_KEY guard in _notify_owner. When testing hero headline text via evaluate(), note that letters are split across spans for reveal animations — use screenshots or check for individual words rather than the full sentence.
rca of the issue: No new bugs found this iteration. Prior iteration bugs (ClipIn reveal + `_id` in response) both verified fixed.
